title: Asking What Matters: Disagreement-Guided Ambiguity Detection for Interactive Text-to-SQL
abstract: arXiv:2611.21645v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interactive text-to-SQL requires an LLM agent not only to generate executable SQL, but also to decide which uncertainty to clarify within a limited interaction budget. However, current clarification policies have three limitations: (i) they target surface ambiguity without testing its SQL impact; (ii) they miss ambiguities implicit in schema routes or domain knowledge; and (iii) they spend limited turns on unfocused or redundant questions. These limitations expose a critical challenge: identifying SQL-impacting ambiguity before the intended SQL is known. In this paper, we propose DisGuAD, a Disagreement-Guided Ambiguity Detection framework that specializes clarification selection. DisGuAD treats disagreement among plausible SQL interpretations as direct evidence of which uncertainty matters to the final query. translated_title: 追问何为关键：面向交互式Text-to-SQL的分歧引导歧义检测
translated_abstract: 交互式text-to-SQL要求大语言模型（LLM）智能体不仅能生成可执行的SQL，还需在有限的交互预算内决定应澄清哪些不确定性。然而，当前的澄清策略存在三个局限：（i）仅针对表面歧义，而不检验该歧义对SQL的影响；（ii）遗漏了隐含在模式路径或领域知识中的歧义；（iii）将有限的对话轮次耗费在不聚焦或冗余的问题上。这些局限揭示了一个关键挑战：在目标SQL尚未确定之前，识别出真正会影响SQL的歧义。本文提出DisGuAD，一个分歧引导的歧义检测框架，专门用于澄清问题的选择。DisGuAD将多个合理SQL解释之间的分歧作为直接证据，用以判断哪些不确定性对最终查询真正重要。具体而言，它构建查询词项清单，通过互补的探测族群引出对比性的SQL解释……
tldr: 提出DisGuAD框架，将多个合理SQL解释之间的分歧作为判断依据，在目标SQL未知的情况下定位真正影响最终查询的歧义，从而在有限的交互轮次内更聚焦、更高效地选择澄清问题，改进交互式text-to-SQL性能。
